feed.title: Feed
feed.empty: Nothing yet. Add a source on the Sources tab and read it.

trust.rss: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed. Read over HTTPS; nothing in a feed is signed.
trust.bluesky: A public author feed, read without signing in. The AppView's answer is trusted as is.
trust.nostr: Each event's id and Schnorr signature are checked against the author's key.
trust.atlas: Each envelope's Falcon-1024 signature is checked, by Atlas's published docs.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rulesHint: In your own words: what matters to you, what to drop, how to label. The curator agent reads these.
settings.autoCurate: Curate new items after each scheduled read
settings.relays: Nostr relays (one wss:// address per line)

published.headline: Title
published.text: What you want to publish, exactly as it should read
published.approvalNote: Nothing is published until it is approved in Approvals, with your passkey if you like.
published.title: Published ({count}) | Published ({count})
published.empty: Nothing published yet. Everything here is signed with this sandbox's key and readable by anyone.

peers.addressPlaceholder: its address: a sandbox host or its own domain
peers.followHint: Its key is pinned on first contact; every entry and checkpoint after is checked against it, and a rewritten history is caught.
peers.title: Followed sandboxes
peers.evidenceKept: Both signed checkpoints are kept as evidence.

discover.title: Discover through guides
discover.hint: Asks the guides in Settings (guides). Each answer is verified against the sandbox it names.
